Every investigation has a story, but how does it end when the paranormal refuses to stay silent? From unsettling encounters to evidence that leaves more questions than answers, the Ghost Adventures crew pushes each investigation to its final moments. But what awaits them when the lockdown comes to an end?
Watch Ghost Adventures, S12, Episodes 5, 7, 1, 9, 2, 8 & 12 on Discovery Channel India.
